title: Inquiry From Netherlands Consulate-General Re E.S.H.

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. D. REGISTER
C. B. D. 7067
12 //

November 12 35.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of
your letter No. 3634 dated November 6, 1935, and to
inform you that there is nothing in the Police records
against Eliahor (Elias) Salim Haron Reuben either from
a political or moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your obedient servant,

〔此处转录不清〕

Deputy Commissioner
(Special Branch)

J. Van den Berg, Esq.,
Netherlands Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ............
Special Branch S.2. ~~xxxxxxxx~~
REPORT
Date November 11th 35

Subject Inquiry from Netherlands Consulate-General re E.S.H. Reuben

Made by D.S. Jones Forwarded by ~~S.B. Cms~~ O.I.

With reference to the attached letter of inquiry dated
November 6, 1935 from the Netherlands Consulate General
regarding the application of Mr Eliahor (Elias) Selim Haron
Reuben for permission to enter the Netherlands Indies, I have
to state that there is no police record of this individual and
nothing is known against him from either a political or moral
point of view.

D.C. Special Branch
~~D.S. Jones~~
D.S.

关于随附的荷兰总领事馆1935年11月6日来函，该函询问 Eliahor (Elias) Selim Haron Reuben 先生申请进入荷属东印度群岛许可一事，本人须声明，此人并无警务记录，且无论出于政治或道德角度，均未发现其有任何不良情形。

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 3634.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
B. D. 7167
8 " " 35

SHANGHAI, 6th November 1935.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Eliahor (Elias)
Salim Haron REUBEN has applied to me for a visé for admission
into the Netherlands Indies.

He is of Iragq nationality and in possession of a passport
issued by the Bureau of Passports in Bagdad, for the Kingdom
of Iragq, on the 6th June 1935, No.1795.

According to his passport he is born in Amarah, Iragq on
the 27th November 1911 and is living in Lane 1070 Avenue Road,
House 19.

He intends to go to Java for business (selling provisions)
and states to have connections with Mr.F.Ellis, residing at
49 Nanking Road, who will supply him with goods and support him
financially.

He states to have been in Java before and in case business
proves satisfactory he wants to stay there.

I should be much obliged to you if you would let me know,
if possible, whether anything is known against Mr.Reuben from
a political or moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔签名〕

Chinese Secretary
for Consul-General.

T.P.Givens, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch)
Shanghai Municipal Police,

SHANGHAI.

S 2. For discreet inquiry and
report please. JWG

Givens.
A.S. Hauchman.

JAB 8/11.

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址：HOLLANDIA。

第 3634 号。

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别科登记室
B. D. 7167
8 " " 35

上海，1935年11月6日。

先生：

谨此告知，Eliahor (Elias) Salim Haron REUBEN 已向本人申请前往荷属东印度群岛的签证。

该人系伊拉克国籍，持有1935年6月6日由巴格达护照签发处为伊拉克王国签发的护照，号码为1795。

根据其护照记载，他于1911年11月27日出生于伊拉克阿马拉（Amarah），现居住于爱文义路（Avenue Road）1070弄19号。

他打算前往爪哇经商（销售食品杂货），并称与居住在南京路49号的 F. Ellis 先生有联系，后者将为其提供货物并在经济上予以支持。

他称此前曾去过爪哇，并表示如果生意顺利，他希望留在那里。

如蒙告知，据贵方所知，Reuben 先生在政治或道德方面是否有任何不良记录，本人将不胜感激。

谨致

敬礼

〔签名〕

总领事馆华务秘书

T.P. Givens 先生，
副总监（特别科）
上海公共租界工部局警务处，

上海。

S 2. 请进行秘密调查并具报。 JWG

Givens.
A.S. Hauchman.

JAB 11月8日。
